title: Senior Associate, Cluster Manager, Current Account, Consumer Banking Group
description:
Lead acquisition, activation, value build-up and retention of high-quality current-account relationships across an assigned cluster. The role owns the cluster’s current-account growth agenda across business segments—including traders, wholesalers, manufacturers, service professionals, institutions and emerging enterprises—while building fee income and cross-sell penetration.

The Cluster Sales Head will lead a team of current-account sales team and relationship managers, work closely with branches and product partners, and ensure the cluster delivers profitable, compliant, transaction-active current-account growth.

**Reporting Structure**

**Job Title**

Cluster Sales Head – Current Accounts

**Function**

Business Banking / Branch Banking / CASA

**Reports To**

Cluster Head

**Coverage**

Defined cluster of branches, catchments and business hubs

**Key Partners**

Branch Managers, Product, Cash Management, POS/QR, Operations, Compliance and Service teams

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Cluster Business Ownership**

* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.

* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.

* Translate cluster targets into branch-, team- and individual-level productivity plans.

* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.

* Improve portfolio quality by prioritising transaction-active, balance-building and cross-sell-ready relationships over dormant or low-value acquisition.

**2. Sales Leadership and Channel Execution**

* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.

* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.

* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.

* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.

* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.

**3. Current-Account Activation and Value Build-Up**

* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.

* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.

* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.

* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.

* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.

**4. Solution-Led Cross-Sell**

* Use the current account as the primary operating hub for business clients and identify the appropriate product solution based on the customer’s business model.

* Drive adoption of corporate internet banking and mobile approvals; cash management and bulk payment solutions; POS, Android POS, QR and Soundbox; sweep-in / sweep-out or FFD structures; debit cards; collections and transaction banking solutions; and promoter, family, wealth and premium savings propositions.

* Partner with product teams to convert business pain points into integrated propositions—for example, POS for collections, Internet Banking for payment controls, FFD for temporary balances and Aspire/premium banking for promoter wallet deepening.

**5. Customer Relationship and Service Governance**

* Build senior-level relationships with anchor clients and participate in strategic joint calls for high-value prospects.

* Ensure timely resolution of onboarding, account-opening, transaction, service and digital-banking issues.

* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.

* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.

* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.

**6. Risk, Compliance and Portfolio Quality**

* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.

* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.

* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.

* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.

**7. People Leadership**

* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.

* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.

* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.

* Identify skill gaps and develop targeted interventions around sales planning, segment understanding, solution selling, digital banking and compliance.

* Maintain a strong talent pipeline and manage attrition proactively.

**Key Performance Indicators**

**Dimension**

**Illustrative KPIs**

**Acquisition**

New-to-bank current accounts, high-value accounts, segment-wise acquisition

**Balance Growth**

AQB/AMB growth, activated accounts, value build-up and balance retention

**Transaction Primacy**

Inward credits, transaction-active accounts and payment/collection volumes

**Revenue**

Fee income, POS/QR revenue, cash-management revenue and cross-sell revenue

**Product Penetration**

Internet banking, POS, debit/business card, FFD, assets and promoter banking

**Portfolio Quality**

Non-activation rate, dormant accounts, early attrition, balance decline and compliance exceptions

**Team Performance**

Productivity per RM, conversion rate, hiring quality, attrition and training completion

**Customer Experience**

Onboarding TAT, service-resolution TAT, complaint trends and retention of top accounts

**Candidate Profile**

**Experience**

* 8–15 years of relevant experience in banking, preferably in current accounts, CASA, business banking, SME banking, transaction banking, branch banking or merchant acquiring.

* At least 3–5 years in a people-leadership role managing sales managers, relationship managers or acquisition teams.

* Demonstrated track record of building a current-account portfolio, increasing operating balances and delivering cross-sell revenue.

* Experience in managing business clusters, market catchments, branch ecosystems or multi-location sales teams is preferred.

**Education**

* Graduate degree required.

* MBA / PGDM in Finance, Sales, Marketing or Banking preferred.

* Relevant certifications in banking, KYC/AML, payments or financial products are an advantage.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of current-account economics, CASA, transaction banking, payments, merchant acquiring and business-client needs.

* Proven ability to lead field sales, build market networks and execute through branches and partner channels.

* Solution-selling mindset with ability to connect client pain points to banking products.

* Strong command of sales analytics, funnel management, portfolio reviews and performance dashboards.

* Excellent stakeholder-management skills across branches, products, operations, risk and service.

* High integrity, sound judgement and uncompromising compliance orientation.

* Strong communication, negotiation, coaching and executive-presence skills.

**Ideal Candidate Statement**

*A high-energy banking sales leader who can build a cluster-wide current-account franchise—not merely open accounts. The successful candidate will create transaction-active, balance-building, profitable client relationships by combining market-led acquisition, disciplined team execution, digital and payment solutions and deep promoter-level engagement.*

Karol Bagh, Delhi

**Job:**

Relationship Management

**Schedule:**

Regular

**Employee Status:**

Full time

title: Wholesale Flower Market Supervisior
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Flower Market Sales & Operations Executive**

**Company:** Sunflower Floral Products  
**Location:** Ghazipur Flower Market, Delhi  
**Department:** Sales & Market Operations  
**Duty Timing:** 2:00 AM to 11:00 AM

**1. Job Purpose**

To manage daily sales and market operations at the flower market counter, ensuring smooth customer service, accurate stock handling, timely order fulfilment and proper accounting of daily transactions.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Customer Handling**

* Attend to walk-in customers, florists, wholesalers and retailers.
* Explain product varieties, quality and pricing.

**B. Stock Management**

* Check opening stock and verify stock received at the market counter.
* Ensure goods are properly arranged and identifiable.
* Record stock issued, sold, returned, damaged or transferred.
* Report shortages, excess stock and damaged material immediately.
* Ensure physical stock matches the daily stock records.

**C. Order Processing & Dispatch**

* Pick and pack goods against customer orders.
* Verify quantities before handing over material.
* Maintain a record of pending, completed and cancelled orders.
* Coordinate with delivery personnel and the main warehouse wherever required.

**D. Cash Handling**

· Collect cash and digital payments and maintain transaction records.

* Record customer credit sales only with authorised approval.
* Reconcile daily sales, collections and outstanding amounts.
* Deposit or hand over collections to the designated person.

**E. Daily Reporting**

* Submit a daily sales report.
* Report opening stock, inward stock, sales, returns and closing stock.
* Report fast-moving items, stock shortages and customer requirements.
* Inform management about operational issues and competitor activity.

**3. Candidate Requirements**

* Minimum 1–3 years of experience in a wholesale market, flower market, vegetable mandi, FMCG distribution or similar business preferred.
* Experience in sales, stock handling and customer dealing.
* Basic arithmetic and ability to maintain simple written or digital records.
* Familiarity with smartphones, WhatsApp and basic billing applications.
* Honest, punctual, responsible and comfortable working independently.
* Must be able to report at 2:00 AM consistently.

**4. Working Conditions**

* Duty hours: 2:00 AM to 11:00 AM, subject to applicable working-hour and break requirements.
* Weekly off as per the approved roster.
* Candidate should preferably live within reasonable commuting distance or have reliable early-morning transport.
* Work involves standing, handling goods and working in a busy wholesale-market environment.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

N.W. Overseas Pvt. Ltd. is a healthcare and medical technology company with a legacy of over 40 years in the healthcare industry. We specialize in the distribution and marketing of medical devices, diagnostic solutions, surgical equipment, and advanced healthcare technologies across India.

Our product portfolio covers multiple medical specialties, along with aesthetic devices and skincare technologies. We work with government departments, hospitals, healthcare institutions, clinics, and medical professionals to deliver innovative healthcare solutions.

The candidate will be responsible for developing government business opportunities, building institutional relationships, identifying new markets, and expanding the company's presence in the healthcare and aesthetics segments.

* Generate leads, arrange product demonstrations, negotiate commercial terms, and convert opportunities into sales.
* Develop and maintain relationships with doctors, hospital administrators, procurement officers, and distributors.
* Identify new territories, customers, and potential business partners.

**3. Marketing & Product Promotion**

* Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, promotional visits, and customer awareness activities.
* Participate in medical conferences, exhibitions, trade fairs, workshops, and industry events.
* Coordinate with the marketing team on promotional materials, product presentations, and lead-generation activities.
* Collect competitor information, market feedback, pricing trends, and customer requirements.

**4. Reporting & Coordination**

* Maintain regular reports of field visits, customer meetings, sales pipelines, and business development activities.
* Coordinate with internal teams for product availability, quotations, tender submissions, deliveries, and after-sales support.
* Follow up on customer requirements, outstanding payments, and order execution.

Eligibility & Qualifications

* Experience in government sales, institutional sales, medical devices, healthcare equipment, or aesthetic devices preferred.
* Experience handling government tenders, GeM, or public-sector procurement will be an added advantage.
* Candidates with experience in medical aesthetics, cosmetology equipment, dermatology devices, or skincare technologies are encouraged to apply.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a willingness to work in field sales may also be considered.

Skills Required

* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Good understanding of field sales and business development.
* Ability to build relationships with government officials and healthcare professionals.
* Knowledge of tendering, GeM, and institutional procurement processes is desirable.
* Target-oriented approach with strong follow-up and lead-conversion skills.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings, product demonstrations, and business development activities.
* Proficiency in MS Office, email communication, and sales reporting.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with an established healthcare and medical technology company.
* Exposure to government business, institutional sales, medical devices, and aesthetic technologies.

* Performance-driven work environment with opportunities for incentives based on company policy.

How to Apply

Join NW Overseas and contribute to the growth of advanced medical and aesthetic technologies across India.

title: Inventory Executive
description:
Role Overview

The Inventory Executive is responsible for the accuracy, control, and timely movement of stock across the warehouse. The role owns day-to-day inventory integrity — receiving, put-away, storage, cycle counting, issue/dispatch, and system transactions — so that physical stock always matches the warehouse management / ERP records. The incumbent works closely with warehouse operations, procurement, quality, and dispatch to prevent shortages, overstock, damage, and unexplained variance.

Key Responsibilities

* **Receiving & inward:** Verify inbound shipments against purchase orders / delivery notes; check quantity, condition, batch/lot and expiry; raise discrepancy notes and coordinate with procurement / vendors.
* **Put-away & storage:** Assign and record bin / rack locations; enforce FIFO / FEFO and segregation of quarantined, damaged, or rejected material; maintain aisle and location hygiene.
* **System transactions:** Post GRN, put-away, transfers, issues, adjustments, and returns in WMS / ERP (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Tally, or equivalent) on the same day as the physical movement.
* **Stock control:** Plan and execute daily / weekly cycle counts and periodic physical inventories; investigate and close variances with root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* **Issuing & dispatch support:** Pick, issue, and reconcile material against production / sales orders; support loading accuracy and documentation (packing lists, invoices, e-way bills as applicable).
* **Documentation & compliance:** Maintain inward/outward registers, batch cards, damage reports, and audit trails; support internal, statutory, and customer audits.
* **Reporting:** Prepare daily stock summaries, ageing / slow-moving reports, near-expiry alerts, and variance dashboards for the Warehouse / Inventory Manager.
* **Coordination:** Liaise with quality for inspections, with stores/production for replenishment, and with security for gate-in/gate-out control.
* **Safety & 5S:** Follow warehouse safety rules, PPE, and material-handling procedures; keep storage areas organised and audit-ready.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Logistics, Supply Chain, Commerce, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 2–5 years of inventory / warehouse experience in a manufacturing, 3PL, FMCG, pharma, or retail distribution environment.
* Hands-on working knowledge of WMS or ERP inventory modules and MS Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, basic data cleaning).
* Familiarity with barcode / RFID scanning, batch-lot control, and FIFO / FEFO practices.

Skills & Competencies

* **Accuracy & attention to detail** — disciplined counting, posting, and documentation with low error rates.
* **Numerical & analytical ability** — comfortable reconciling quantities, values, and location-level stock.
* **Process discipline** — follows SOPs, escalation paths, and cut-off times without shortcuts.
* **Communication** — clear written notes and verbal coordination with operations, vendors, and auditors.
* **Problem solving** — traces variances to receiving, put-away, picking, or system errors and closes the loop.
* **Integrity** — trustworthy handling of high-value or controlled stock; no unauthorised adjustments.

Working Conditions

Based at the warehouse floor and inventory office. The role involves walking the aisles, climbing safe racking access where required, and using handheld scanners. Shift work, early starts, or weekend / month-end stock-takes may apply depending on site operations. Personal protective equipment must be worn in operational areas.

Key Performance Indicators (Indicative)

* Inventory accuracy (book vs. physical) at location and SKU level.
* Cycle-count completion rate and variance closure turnaround.
* Same-day posting of receipts, issues, and transfers.
* Ageing / near-expiry / slow-moving stock flagged within SLA.
* Audit findings related to inventory documentation and control.

description:

**Job description**

* **Job Description:**

**Name of Organisation**

**TARAjeevan (Production, Quality and Product Support)**

  

**Position Title**

**Technical Officer**

  

**Location**

**TARAjeevan, Ghitorni, New Delhi**

  

**No. of Positions**

**01**

  

**Job Type**

**Contractual**

* **Executive Summary**
* Provide technical leadership for TARAjeevan's production and quality function. Own reagent chemistry, kit quality, laboratory standards and inventory, so that every kit leaving Ghitorni performs as specified and production continuity is built on documented processes and trained staff.
* Consolidate and maintain the product's technical knowledge base, and support the GM (Sales and Business Development) on certification, cost reduction and product development.
* **Role mandate**
* The role holder will be responsible for the technical integrity of the TARAjeevan product line, covering reagent preparation and standardisation, final testing of kits, calibration of instruments, batch records, inventory of chemicals and consumables, and the training and supervision of production staff. The role holder will also provide hands-on support for the water purification and filter line, including assembly, servicing and field troubleshooting, and will act as the technical counterpart to the GM on certification, supplier evaluation, cost reduction and the digitization pathway. The role sits within a social-enterprise group with a strong development mandate; the role holder is expected to work collaboratively with production staff and long-serving colleagues, and to build the team's capability rather than operate as a lone specialist. Success is measured by kit quality and consistency, zero stock-outs of critical reagents, documented processes, and the resilience of the production function.
* **Core accountabilities**
* + **Reagent preparation, testing and quality assurance**

    - Prepare and standardise reagents for all kit parameters, including pH, TDS, hardness, chlorine, arsenic, fluoride and bacteriological tests, in accordance with APHA, BIS and WHO methods.
    - Carry out final testing of every production batch against reference standards before release, and maintain reference samples.
    - Operate and periodically calibrate laboratory equipment, maintaining calibration records.
    - Investigate customer feedback on kit performance, trace root cause to batch and reagent, and institute corrective action.
* **KPIs**
* + 100% of batches tested and released against a written release protocol within the first 60 days.
  + Calibration schedule in place and adhered to for all instruments.
  + Customer feedback on kit performance investigated and closed within 7 working days, with a root-cause record.
  + Zero batches recalled for reagent failure.
* + **Production supervision and continuity**

    - Supervise and train production staff in kit assembly, packaging, labelling and reagent handling to a written standard.
    - Document all production processes, formulations, sources and methods so that every step is covered by a written procedure.
    - Ensure cross-training such that assembly and dispatch continue uninterrupted in the absence of any individual, including the role holder.
* **KPIs**
* + Written standard operating procedures for all production and reagent steps within 90 days.
  + At least 2 persons trained and able to perform every critical production step by end of the first 2 quarters.
  + No confirmed order delayed for want of technical sign-off.
* + **Technical documentation**

    - Systematically capture formulations, vendor specifications, process know-how and historical quality data from past and present contributors, from the organisation's technical advisers, and from existing records and systems.
    - Build and maintain a technical master file covering chemistry, BOM specifications, supplier details and test methods.
* **KPIs**
* + Technical master file complete and reviewed by the technical adviser within the first quarter.
  + All historical technical records retrieved and indexed within 60 days.
* + **Inventory and supplier technical management**

    - Maintain inventory of reagents, chemicals, filter media, glassware and packaging, with reorder levels set to cover large orders, particularly for arsenic reagents and other long-lead items.
    - Specify chemical grades and quality requirements for suppliers, evaluate alternative vendors and incoming material quality, and support the GM in supplier negotiations and the BOM review.
* **KPIs**
* + Zero stock-outs of critical reagents after the first 60 days.
  + Incoming material quality checks recorded for every delivery.
  + At least 2 alternative vendors qualified for each critical chemical within Year 1.
* + **Purification and filter line support**

    - Assemble, test and service water filter and arsenic removal units, including cartridge replacement.
    - Undertake field visits for installation, customer training and troubleshooting as required.
    - Support the technical assessment of purification products under development and the work needed to bring them to market.
* **KPIs**
* + Service and field-visit log maintained for all units.
  + Technical assessment of purification products documented within the first 2 quarters.
* + **Certification, safety and workspace**

    - Support the GM in maintaining NABL and any further certification, keeping the records and laboratory conditions required for compliance.
    - Maintain the laboratory and production areas to safety, hygiene and chemical-handling standards, including safe storage and disposal of hazardous reagents.
    - Keep batch records, service logs and data entries current in spreadsheets or logbooks.
* **KPIs**
* + Laboratory in audit-ready condition at all times, with a monthly self-inspection record.
  + Chemical storage and disposal register in place within 30 days.
  + No safety incidents.
* **Candidate expectations**:
* + BSc in chemistry or allied science, polytechnic diploma, or vocational training certificate
  + Experience: 1 to 2 years' experience in a laboratory, quality control or assembly setting preferred.
  + Comfortable with basic laboratory tools, digital scales, pipettes and graduated glassware
  + able to follow formulations, measurement guides and colour-matching charts with precision.
  + Basic computer skills for data entry and inventory management.
  + Physically able to stand for extended periods.
  + A quick learner with high accuracy on repetitive tasks, strong hygiene awareness, clear communication, a collaborative disposition and willingness to travel for field work.
* **How to Apply?**
* Please submit your updated curriculum vitae (CV), including 200 words cover letter explaining why you think you are suitable for the job of **“Technical Officer”****.**
* Applications can be e-mailed to careers@devalt.org. The last date to submit your application is
    
  **01 November 2026** with subject **Job Application –** **“****Technical Officer****”**. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

**General Manager - Sales and Business Development**

**TARAjeevan, Ghitorni, New Delhi**

**01**

* **Executive Summary**: Convert TARAjeevan's proven product (the Jal Tara Kit), the DA/TARA brand equity and a substantial dormant customer base into a growing, collected order book through direct institutional sales, government-programme penetration and a distributor and franchise channel. Year 1 targets are a floor, not the ambition; the 3-to-5-year objective is an order book of INR 2 to 5 crores, with tripling of annual kit revenue within 24 months as the first staging post.
* **Role mandate**
* The role holder will own the TARAjeevan revenue line end to end and carry subsidiary responsibility for general management of the unit. This includes identifying and engaging institutional buyers, reactivating lapsed accounts, building and managing a protected distributor and franchise channel, converting interest into collected revenue while safeguarding margins, and overseeing day-to-day operations, production continuity and staff coordination. The role holder is expected to master the whole business quickly and build a credible plan for scaling it to crore-level revenues. The role sits within a social-enterprise group with a strong development mandate; the role holder is expected to build and carry the team, working collaboratively with long-serving colleagues and drawing on their institutional knowledge rather than working around them. Success is measured by collected revenue, kits sold, debtor days, active accounts, channel partners generating repeat offtake, and operational resilience.
* **Core accountabilities**
* + **Direct institutional sales and account reactivation**
* + Mine and reactivate the historical customer base held in company records, prioritising known repeat buyers in the first 90 days.
  + Build named account plans across Jal Jeevan Mission and PHED departments, primary health centres, hospitals, schools, health-focused NGOs and food-service establishments.
  + Own the full cycle from lead to collection, maintaining CRM-quality records of all interactions, quotes, orders, receivables and next steps.
  + Pursue GeM listing and government-tender readiness for institutional procurement.
* **KPIs**
* + Minimum INR 8 to 10 L of new collected revenue within the 6-month probation period.
  + INR 15 to 20 L of incremental collected revenue in Year 1.
  + 15 or more active institutional accounts by end of Year 1, with debtor days below 45
      
    Qualified pipeline maintained at 3x the quarterly target, reviewed weekly.
* + **Distributor and franchise channel development**

    - Prepare and present a first-cut distributor and franchise structure within the first 60 days, covering candidate profiles, territory logic, wholesale pricing, minimum-offtake conditions and legal safeguards.
    - Design and pilot the model with enforceable NDAs, non-compete clauses and minimum-offtake conditions tied to territory exclusivity.
    - Prioritise health-focused NGOs and government-supply operators as first franchisees.
    - Establish wholesale pricing, ordering and replenishment processes that protect the company's commercial interests.
* **KPIs**
* + First-cut distributor and franchise structure presented for management approval within 60 days of joining.
  + 3 to 5 distributors or franchisees signed with paid first orders in Year 1.
  + Each channel partner delivering INR 3 to 5 L annual offtake at steady state.
  + No channel agreement executed without a legal-grade NDA and minimum-offtake clause.
* + **General management and operational resilience**

    - Oversee production scheduling, order fulfilment and quality assurance in coordination with the production team, ensuring continuity is never dependent on a single individual.
    - Coordinate inventory planning for key components, including pre-stocking of critical chemicals for large orders.
    - Support day-to-day decision-making on working conditions, workflows and workspace standards, escalating only investment and financial-commitment decisions.
* **KPIs**
* + Documented production and fulfilment backup arrangements in place within the first quarter.
  + Inventory availability such that no confirmed order is delayed for want of components.
  + Workspace and process improvement plan submitted within 90 days.
* + **Internal referral channel and marketing**

    - Activate DA field-staff referrals through a unit-level incentive mechanism, ensuring TARAjeevan is top of mind whenever field teams encounter water-testing needs.
    - Develop basic sales collateral, pricing sheets and a tender-response capability.
    - Represent TARAjeevan at relevant health, WASH and government forums.
* **KPIs**
* + 10 or more orders originated through internal DA referrals in Year 1.
  + Collateral and price lists current at all times, with tender responses within stipulated deadlines.
* + **Product competitiveness, digitization and market intelligence**

    - Evaluate white-label and OEM partnerships for digital, microprocessor-based water testing, including sensor-based multi-parameter options, and present a costed digitization pathway for management decision.
    - Gather structured market intelligence on competing products, buyer concerns and adoption barriers, benchmarking the kit against both conventional and digital alternatives.
    - Produce a monthly sales MIS covering pipeline, conversions, debtor ageing and margin per order.
* **KPIs**
* + Costed digitization or white-label proposal presented within the first 2 quarters.
  + Documented competitor and pricing assessment updated quarterly.
  + Monthly MIS delivered without fail.
* + **Commercial hygiene, cost reduction and compliance**

    - Lead supplier negotiations and a full BOM review to reduce kit cost, closing the price gap with competing products while protecting margins.
    - Own the currency of all product certifications and regulatory requirements, including verification and renewal of NABL certification and any further accreditation needed to legitimise the kit for institutional procurement.
    - Feed supplier, pricing and cost intelligence back into pricing reviews on an ongoing basis.
* **KPIs**
* + Refreshed BOM with negotiated supplier pricing within the first quarter.
  + Demonstrated reduction in kit production cost within Year 1 without compromising quality.
  + All certifications verified within the first 60 days and maintained current thereafter, with a compliance register in place.
  + At least 2 actionable cost-reduction or pricing recommendations per year arising from field intelligence.
* **Candidate expectations**:
* + Demonstrated institutional or B2B sales record, preferably in water, health, diagnostics or allied sectors. Comfortable in a lean, capital-conscious environment.
  + Able to build and carry a small team, respect institutional memory.
  + Able to work collaboratively within a social-enterprise culture.
* **How to Apply?**
* Please submit your updated curriculum vitae (CV), including 200 words cover letter explaining why you think you are suitable for the job of **“General Manager - Sales and Business Development”****.**
* Applications can be e-mailed to careers@devalt.org. The last date to submit your application is **01 November 2026** with subject **Job Application –** **“****GM-Sales and Business Development****”**. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

**About the Company**

Asahi Ropes Pvt. Ltd. is a premier manufacturer and supplier of high-performance industrial ropes, steel wire ropes, and lifting solutions. We serve major OEMs, infrastructure giants, crane manufacturers, elevator companies, and an extensive network of distributors across India and international markets.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a mature, dynamic, and result-oriented **Sales Head** with proven leadership in Industrial B2B Sales to lead our nationwide sales force. The ideal candidate must be a strategic vision-holder who brings deep market intelligence, robust OEM relationships, and strong team-building capabilities. You will be responsible for defining the company's long-term sales roadmap, expanding market share, and driving sustainable revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities & Strategic Deliverables**

**1. Sales Strategy & Business Growth**

* Formulate and implement aggressive national sales strategies aligned with overall business goals.
* Drive top-line revenue growth across all key segments: **OEMs, Direct Industrial Buyers, Government/PSU Tenders, and Dealer/Distributor Networks**.
* Identify new market opportunities, expansion geographies, and unaddressed industry verticals PAN India and globally.

**2. Key Account Management & OEM Acquisition**

* Lead high-value techno-commercial negotiations and build C-suite relationships with top OEM accounts (Elevators, Cranes, Mining, Infrastructure, Shipping, etc.).
* Standardize the company's approach to long-cycle sales, large contracts, and annual rate agreements (RCs).

**3. Channel & Distribution Network Scaling**

* Audit, strengthen, and expand the PAN-India dealer and distributor ecosystem.
* Establish clear channel policies, margin structures, credit limits, and performance incentives to maintain market discipline and channel loyalty.

**4. Leadership & Team Management**

* Mentor, manage, and scale a high-performing team of Regional Sales Managers (RSMs), Business Development Managers (BDMs), and Sales Executives.
* Set Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), conduct quarterly performance reviews, and build a culture of accountability and high execution.

**5. Operations, Commercials & Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Maintain strict oversight on receivables, credit control, and cash flow cycles in coordination with the Finance team.
* Collaborate closely with **Production, QA/QC, and Logistics** to ensure timely execution of orders, minimal rejection rates, and high customer satisfaction.
* Provide accurate demand forecasting to the supply chain team to optimize inventory and production planning.

**Mandatory Requirement**

**Age Limit**

**45 Years to 55 Years** *(Mandatory Age Bracket)*

**Minimum 15+ Years** in Industrial / B2B Sales

**Qualification**

**B.Tech (Mechanical / Civil / Production)** OR **MBA in Marketing / International Business** (Dual degree preferred)

**Industry Background**

Industrial Products, Steel Wire Ropes, Lifting Equipment, Heavy Machinery, Material Handling, Elevators, Cranes, or related B2B sectors

**Language Skills**

**Fluency in English** (Spoken & Business Writing) is mandatory

Readiness to travel extensively across India for client visits and team reviews

* **Techno-Commercial Expertise:** Strong capability to handle technical specifications alongside commercial terms, contract clauses, and risk management.

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and customer-focused Senior Executive – Hotel & Holiday Operations to manage hotel reservations, holiday package operations, supplier coordination, and end-to-end travel arrangements. **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Hotel Operations & Reservations**

**3. Vendor & Supplier Management**

* Build and maintain strong working relationships with hotels, DMCs, transport companies, and other travel service providers.
* Source new suppliers and negotiate competitive rates to improve profitability.
* Evaluate vendors based on pricing, service quality, reliability, and response time.
* Follow up on pending confirmations, vouchers, invoices, refunds, and supplier payments in coordination with the accounts team.

**4. Customer Service & Coordination**

* Coordinate with the sales team to understand client requirements and provide operational support.
* Ensure timely sharing of booking confirmations, hotel vouchers, itineraries, and travel documents.
* Handle customer queries, special requests, complaints, and service-related escalations.
* Provide on-trip assistance and coordinate with local suppliers to resolve emergencies or service issues.
* Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction throughout the travel journey.

**5. Costing, Documentation & MIS**

* Prepare accurate package costing and maintain healthy profit margins.
* Track supplier costs, selling prices, markups, and booking profitability.

* Prepare regular MIS reports on bookings, pending confirmations, cancellations, and operational performance.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in Travel & Tourism, Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in hotel reservations, holiday operations, or travel package operations.
* Strong knowledge of domestic and international holiday destinations.
* Experience in hotel rate negotiation, package costing, supplier coordination, and itinerary preparation.
* Good understanding of hotel categories, room types, meal plans, cancellation policies, and booking procedures.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, email communication, and online booking platforms.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize deadlines, and work in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and a customer-first approach.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with DMCs, B2B travel portals, hotel aggregators, and travel suppliers.

* Knowledge of travel operations software, CRM systems, and hotel contracting tools.

**1. Role Overview**

The ideal candidate will combine **AI-powered data analytics, on-ground market intelligence, consumer and retailer behaviour, distributor economics and unconventional sales strategies** to identify growth opportunities and improve sales productivity.

* Develop predictive models and actionable insights to forecast demand, identify potential stock-outs, improve sales planning and prioritise high-value outlets.

* Build simple, practical dashboards and decision-support systems that help management and the sales team take faster, better-informed decisions.

**B. On-Ground Market Intelligence**

* Conduct regular market visits to understand the realities of general trade, including retailer behaviour, product availability, competitor activity, pricing, margins and consumer demand.
* Understand why retailers recommend certain brands, what drives shelf placement, and what prevents them from stocking or reordering our products.
* Gather structured feedback from retailers, wholesalers, distributors and sales representatives.
* Evaluate competitor schemes, trade margins, credit practices, merchandising, product assortment and distribution models.
* Validate data-driven recommendations through field experiments and direct market observation.
* Convert market feedback into specific, actionable sales growth initiatives.

**C. Retailer & Distributor Growth Strategies**

* Understand the commercial motivations, pain points and expectations of retailers, wholesalers and distributors.
* Develop strategies to increase retailer acquisition, active outlet coverage, order frequency, assortment and repeat purchases.
* Design innovative distributor engagement programmes that improve throughput, productivity and willingness to invest in the brand.
* Identify ways to improve retailer economics and product attractiveness without unnecessarily increasing trade expenditure.
* Develop differentiated strategies for high-potential retailers, low-productivity outlets, dormant accounts and strategically important distributors.
* Improve the effectiveness of the company's distribution network and sales force deployment.

**D. Creative & Innovative Sales Strategy Development**

* Conceptualise unconventional, high-impact sales initiatives that can create incremental demand and improve product movement.
* Develop new trade schemes, retailer incentive structures, sampling programmes, visibility initiatives, bundled offers and market activation strategies.
* Explore alternative methods of generating retail demand, improving product recommendation and increasing consumer pull.
* Design territory-specific and channel-specific growth strategies instead of relying on uniform schemes across all markets.
* Run controlled pilots to test new ideas, measure results, understand unit economics and scale successful interventions.
* Challenge conventional FMCG sales practices and continuously identify new ways to improve market penetration and sales productivity.

**E. Sales Force Effectiveness**

* Analyse the productivity of Area Sales Managers, Sales Officers and field sales teams using sales, outlet coverage, visit and order-conversion data.
* Identify gaps between field activity and actual commercial outcomes.
* Recommend ways to improve productive calls, conversion rates, outlet activation and sales per salesperson.
* Develop data-led outlet prioritisation and beat optimisation strategies.
* Equip the sales team with actionable market insights, outlet-level opportunities and clear growth plans.
* Work with sales leadership to convert strategic recommendations into field execution.

**F. Commercial Evaluation & Performance Measurement**

* Establish measurable KPIs for every sales growth initiative.
* Evaluate incremental sales, gross margins, scheme costs, return on investment, repeat ordering and retailer activation.
* Distinguish genuine incremental sales from stock loading, channel inventory build-up or purchases merely shifted between periods.
* Develop a structured process for reviewing experiments, learning from unsuccessful initiatives and scaling successful ones.
* Present concise, data-backed recommendations and performance reviews to senior management.

**3. Key Deliverables**

The candidate will be expected to deliver:

* **Market Growth Opportunities:** A prioritised assessment of growth opportunities by geography, SKU, distributor and retail outlet.
* **Retailer Activation Strategy:** A structured plan to increase active outlets, retailer acquisition and repeat orders.
* **Distributor Productivity Improvement:** Strategies to improve distributor throughput, coverage and commercial engagement.
* **AI-Led Sales Intelligence:** Practical dashboards, analytical models and insights that guide daily and monthly sales decisions.
* **Innovative Sales Experiments:** A pipeline of new initiatives, with defined hypotheses, budgets, pilot markets and measurable outcomes.
* **Sales Force Productivity:** Recommendations to improve field-force effectiveness and conversion of market visits into orders.
* **Growth Performance Reviews:** Regular reporting on incremental sales, profitability, initiative effectiveness and lessons learned.

**4. Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–10 years of relevant experience in FMCG sales strategy, general trade, trade marketing, revenue growth management, sales analytics or commercial strategy.
* Strong understanding of Indian general trade distribution, including distributors, wholesalers, kirana stores and traditional retail channels.
* Demonstrated ability to combine quantitative analysis with practical market understanding.
* Experience using AI tools, advanced Excel or predictive analytics would be an advantage.
* Ability to interpret large datasets and translate findings into clear commercial actions.
* Strong understanding of trade margins, retailer economics, distributor profitability, sales schemes and channel incentives.
* Creative problem-solving ability and a track record of developing or implementing innovative sales initiatives.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence field teams and senior management.
* Willingness to travel regularly and spend substantial time in the market.

**5. Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in one or more of the following environments:

* FMCG companies with extensive general trade distribution.
* Sales strategy, revenue growth management or trade marketing teams.
* Data-led sales transformation or commercial analytics roles.
* Emerging consumer brands that have built distribution through innovative trade strategies.
* Consulting or analytics roles involving hands-on implementation of sales growth initiatives.

Experience in food, staples, sugar, packaged foods, traditional Indian products or other high-frequency consumer categories would be an advantage.

**6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be measured on tangible business outcomes, including:

* Growth in secondary sales and sales throughput.
* Increase in active retail outlets and productive distribution reach.
* Improvement in retailer acquisition and repeat-order rates.
* Growth in average order value and SKU penetration per outlet.
* Improvement in distributor productivity and territory performance.
* Incremental gross contribution generated by sales initiatives.
* Return on investment from trade schemes and market activation programmes.
* Improvement in sales-force productivity.
* Number of successful growth experiments implemented and scaled.
* Adoption and demonstrated commercial impact of AI-led decision-making.

**7. What Success Looks Like**

A successful candidate will be able to answer questions such as:

* Which retailers should our sales team target tomorrow to generate the highest incremental sales?
* Why are retailers not stocking or reordering our products, and how do we change that behaviour?
* Which trade scheme will generate genuine incremental demand rather than simply increase discounts?
* Which distributors have the highest untapped potential, and what will motivate them to grow our business?
* Which SKUs and markets offer the best opportunities for profitable growth?
* How can AI and sales data help us make better decisions than our competitors?
* What new, unconventional strategies can help us increase market penetration and sell more at the retail counter?

**The ultimate objective is simple: turn data, market intelligence and creative thinking into measurable, profitable and sustainable general trade sales growth.**

title: Lead Research Executive
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and research-driven **Lead Research Executive** to identify potential business clients and build accurate, relevant prospect databases for our sales and business development team.

You will research businesses using Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART, LinkedIn, company websites, and other online sources. Your responsibilities will include identifying suitable businesses, finding business owners and decision-makers, collecting and verifying contact information, and identifying companies that may benefit from our digital marketing services.

The ideal candidate enjoys online research, understands how to evaluate business prospects, and takes pride in maintaining clean, reliable, and well-organized data.

**Our priority is lead quality, data accuracy, and prospect relevance—not simply collecting large volumes of random contacts.**

Key Responsibilities1. Online Business & Prospect Research

* Research businesses using Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART, LinkedIn, company websites, business directories, and other relevant online sources.
* Identify potential clients based on industry, location, business type, company size, and other defined criteria.
* Research businesses that may need digital marketing, website development, SEO, paid advertising, or related agency services.
* Explore different industries and local markets to discover relevant business opportunities.
* Follow research guidelines and maintain consistent standards when identifying potential clients.

2. Contact & Decision-Maker Research

* Identify business owners, founders, directors, marketing heads, and other relevant decision-makers.
* Find available business contact information, including company email addresses, business phone numbers, LinkedIn profiles, and website details.
* Research company websites and public business profiles to understand their services and operations.
* Verify available contact information before adding it to the prospect database.
* Record the source of information where required to support accuracy and future verification.

3. Prospect Identification & Lead Qualification

* Identify businesses that may have a genuine need for digital marketing services.
* Research newly launched businesses and companies showing signs of growth or expansion.
* Identify businesses with weak websites, outdated online information, limited social media activity, or other potential improvement opportunities.
* Look for publicly visible indications that businesses are investing in advertising or marketing.
* Evaluate prospects against defined criteria and prioritize those that best match the target customer profile.
* Distinguish relevant business prospects from companies that do not fit the requirements.

4. Data Verification & Database Management

* Build and maintain organized prospect databases using Excel, Google Sheets, or CRM systems.
* Check contact details and company information for accuracy and relevance.
* Remove duplicate records and flag invalid, outdated, or incomplete information.
* Standardize company names, locations, contact fields, and other database information.
* Segment prospects by industry, location, business category, and other useful criteria.
* Maintain clear and consistent records so the sales team can use the data efficiently.

5. Research Reporting & Process Improvement

* Maintain records of research sources, completed lists, and prospect qualification status.
* Follow assigned research criteria, deadlines, and data quality standards.
* Report incomplete information, recurring data issues, and difficulties in finding relevant prospects.
* Identify useful directories, research methods, and sources that improve lead quality.
* Coordinate with the sales and business development team to understand which prospects are most valuable.
* Refine research methods based on feedback and the quality of leads generated.

Tools & Platforms

* **Business Research:** Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART
* **Professional Research:** LinkedIn and company websites
* **Additional Sources:** Business directories and other relevant public online sources
* **Data Management:** Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
* **Lead Management:** CRM software and internal tracking systems

Skills & Qualifications

* Strong online research and information-gathering skills.
* Ability to identify businesses based on specific industry, location, and customer criteria.
* Familiarity with Google Maps, Justdial, IndiaMART, LinkedIn, or similar research platforms.
* Ability to identify business owners and relevant decision-makers.
* Understanding of contact research, data verification, and prospect database building.
* Basic knowledge of B2B lead generation and lead qualification.
* Good attention to detail and ability to identify duplicate or inaccurate records.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and organized data entry.
* Ability to follow instructions, meet deadlines, and maintain consistent research quality.
* A proactive approach to identifying useful information and relevant business opportunities.

Prior experience with lead research, data research, market research, contact research, or B2B prospecting is an advantage.

Experience Requirements

**Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome to apply.**

Freshers with strong online research skills, attention to detail, and basic spreadsheet knowledge can apply.

Candidates with experience in lead research, B2B prospect research, data research, market research, contact databases, or lead generation will be preferred.

How Success Is Measured

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Relevance of businesses identified against the target customer profile.
* Accuracy and completeness of contact information.
* Quality of decision-maker identification.
* Number of valid, verified, and usable prospects delivered.
* Consistency in removing duplicates and maintaining clean databases.
* Ability to identify promising businesses with potential digital marketing needs.
* Timely delivery and adherence to research criteria.
* Feedback from the sales team on the usefulness of the leads.

We value **accurate research, qualified prospects, and actionable business data over raw database size.**

Who Should Apply?

This opportunity is ideal for freshers, online researchers, data research executives, lead research executives, and candidates interested in B2B prospecting and business development.

If you enjoy researching businesses, finding useful information online, identifying potential customers, and organizing accurate data, we encourage you to apply.

**Apply now to help our sales team discover relevant businesses and build a reliable pipeline of potential clients.**

title: Assistant Manager, Key Accounts
description:
Inc42 Media is looking for a sharp, relationship-driven Assistant Manager / Manager – Key Accounts to own a book of BrandLabs accounts end-to-end – the single point of contact between our clients and our internal teams across content & marketing campaigns. This is a role for a persuasive communicator who can build deep, trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, and use those relationships to retain and expand revenue from assigned accounts.

This role runs on a defined Key Account Management operating system — a scorecard that measures your accounts across Inputs (20%), Outputs (30%), and Outcomes (50%), a review cadence, renewal runways, and a governance layer. You won't have to invent the system; you'll operate it with discipline, make it hum, and — as you grow — help own and evolve it.

You'll own the full arc of an account — curating sharp concepts & proposals, orchestrating flawless delivery across BrandLabs properties (events, articles, videos, reports, custom programmes and more), and turning every campaign into a reason for clients to come back and spend more. Just as importantly, we want someone who is AI-native: you instinctively reach for AI tools to research faster, write tighter, build better decks, and free up time for the relationship-building that actually moves the needle.

Think of this as the role our best key-account leaders held earlier in their journey. You step in to run the OS on a live book of accounts today; the trajectory is to own it, sharpen it, and lead a pod as the vertical scales.

**About Inc42 Media**

Inc42 is India's #1 startup media & intelligence platform that informs, educates, and empowers startup & business leaders through its incisive reporting, insightful reports, curated events & communities, and industry-leading executive courses & programs.

Since launching in January 2015 and rising to become the authoritative voice on India's startup economy, we've moved markets, gotten the early scoop on billions of dollars of transactions, and told the inside story of some of the fastest-growing startups & industries alike. Our stories have been followed by the Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters, TechCrunch, and other major outlets hundreds of times. Through Inc42 BrandLabs, we partner with enterprises & brands to create branded content & experiences that reach our audience of decision makers.

**The Inc42 Impact**

* Inc42 stories reach over 50 Mn+ people monthly
* Published more than 55,000 stories
* Successfully conducted 125+ events
* Launched 100+ research reports
* Receives 500+ startup applications monthly
* Worked with 350+ brands

**Why This Role Is Unique**

* Driving new revenue opportunities: You'll be the lynchpin on major revenue bets for Inc42 BrandLabs — retaining, growing, and cross-selling into your book of accounts.
* Anchoring relationships: You'll own client satisfaction and the metrics that matter — Net Promoter Score, repeat business, and account churn.
* Market experimentation: You'll help stand up new revenue channels and enable go-to-market motions for new formats and segments.
* Building for scale: This role is central to growing revenue from existing clients and is expected to develop into a team-leading position as the vertical scales.

**What You'll Own**

Your performance mirrors how every account is scored. The three layers below are exactly how success is measured — the weightings tell you where to spend your energy.

**1. Relationship & Activity Discipline — Inputs (20%)**

* Be the trusted point of contact for your accounts and build depth beyond a single stakeholder — widen coverage so no account depends on one relationship.
* Run a consistent meeting and interaction cadence (weekly / monthly / quarterly), logging planned-vs-actual so nothing slips.
* Keep the account record — the single source of truth — accurate and current: contacts, contract values, renewal dates, activity.

**2. Concepts, Proposals, Delivery & Reporting — Outputs (30%)**

* Curate customized content & branding concepts and translate them into compelling proposals, RFP responses, and pitch decks across BrandLabs properties.
* Own delivery quality end-to-end — plan execution, coordinate with internal production & content teams, marketing, event ops, Founders' Office, finance, and other stakeholders.
* Report campaign performance to clients and the sales team at a defined cadence, turning data into insight the client values.

**3. Retention & Expansion — Outcomes (50%)**

* Own the commercial outcomes for your book: gross revenue retention (keep what we have) and net revenue retention (grow it through upsell and cross-sell).
* Manage every renewal on its 90/60/30-day runway — no renewal should ever come as a surprise.
* Own client NPS, repeat business, and churn; anticipate needs before the client raises them.

**4. Governance & No-Surprises**

* Surface risks and escalations early through a structured, no-surprises review — flag a wobbling account before it becomes a lost one.
* Drive coordination with internal teams and improve the processes that make delivery smoother.

**5. AI-Native Ways of Working**

* Use AI tools smartly across the whole workflow — research and market mapping, proposal and deck drafting, meeting notes and follow-ups, reporting, and client communication.
* Continuously find ways to compress turnaround and raise output quality with AI, and share what works with the team.

**How Success Is Measured**

Concretely, you'll be measured on:

* Outcomes (50%): Repeat business, renewal timeliness, & NPS.
* Outputs (30%): Proposal quality and win rate, delivery quality, and reporting consistency.
* Inputs (20%): Cadence adherence, relationship coverage, and data hygiene on the account record.

**Who We Are Looking For**

**Must-have**

* Executive communication & relationship-building: builds trust fast with senior client stakeholders, holds their ground, and multi-threads an account. This is the single most important trait for the role.
* Revenue retention & expansion instinct: comfortable owning retention and driving upsell/cross-sell, and working a renewal to a timely close.
* Concept & proposal curation: turns a brief into a sharp concept and a genuinely persuasive proposal, deck, or RFP response.
* AI-native execution: already uses AI tools daily to research, draft, and speed up delivery — and eager to push further.
* Account & project management with P&L discipline: runs projects end-to-end and protects delivery quality and margin.
* Data & scorecard fluency: comfortable operating inside a metrics-driven system — reading a dashboard and making decisions from the numbers (sharp Excel/Google Sheets).
* Cadence & governance discipline: runs a review rhythm and a no-surprises escalation habit reliably, without being chased.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience (media solutions, consulting, SaaS, or brand/agency account management) with front-end client ownership. Bachelor's or Master's in Engineering/Tech, Sales, Marketing, Business, or equivalent.

**Good-to-have**

* Startup-ecosystem / media & branded-content domain knowledge — understands Inc42's world and audience.
* Negotiation skills, specifically on renewals and expansion pricing.
* Analytical storytelling — turning campaign performance into insight a client will pay to keep hearing.
* Comfort with CRM & project tools (e.g., Asana) and light BI/dashboarding.
* Early signs of team leadership / mentoring — this role is expected to grow into leading a pod.

**Why This Role Is Special**

* A system, not a scramble: you inherit a proven operating system and scorecard — clarity on exactly what good looks like from day one.
* Clear growth trajectory: operate the system now; own it, sharpen it, and lead a team as the vertical scales.
* Founder proximity & autonomy: direct exposure to leadership on high-stakes accounts, with the independence to drive outcomes your way.
* Massive visibility: be the face of Inc42 BrandLabs to some of India's most exciting brands and decision makers.

title: Cold Email Lead Generation Executive
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and results-driven **Cold Email Lead Generation Executive** to build targeted B2B prospect lists, run cold email campaigns, and generate qualified business opportunities.

You will be responsible for the complete cold email lead generation process, including business data extraction, decision-maker research, email finding and verification, campaign setup, inbox management, email deliverability, follow-ups, and lead tracking.

The ideal candidate understands how to reach the right prospects, maintain clean and accurate databases, improve email deliverability, and create personalized outreach campaigns that generate meaningful responses.

**Our focus is on verified prospects, emails reaching the inbox, positive replies, and qualified leads — not simply the number of emails sent.**

Key Responsibilities1. B2B Lead Research & Data Extraction

* Extract business information from Google Maps, business directories, company websites, LinkedIn, and other relevant public sources.
* Build targeted prospect lists based on industry, location, business type, company size, and ideal customer profile.
* Identify key decision-makers, including founders, business owners, CEOs, directors, and marketing heads.
* Research company information and enrich existing databases using lead generation platforms, AI tools, and data enrichment solutions.
* Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date prospect databases.

2. Email Finding, Verification & Database Management

* Find professional business email addresses for relevant decision-makers using email finder and data enrichment tools.
* Verify email addresses before adding prospects to campaigns.
* Clean, deduplicate, segment, and maintain prospect lists to minimize invalid addresses and improve targeting.
* Maintain organized records in CRM systems, Excel, or Google Sheets.
* Regularly update prospect data and remove invalid, unsubscribed, or suppressed contacts.

3. Cold Email Campaign Setup & Execution

* Set up and manage cold email campaigns using platforms such as Instantly, Smartlead, or lemlist.
* Configure sending domains, inboxes, and email authentication protocols, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Monitor inbox health and sender reputation, and use appropriate sending practices to support deliverability.
* Create and execute personalized, segmented cold email campaigns with relevant follow-up sequences.
* Use AI writing and automation tools to improve personalization, research efficiency, and campaign workflows.
* Coordinate campaign targeting, messaging, and sending schedules based on business objectives.

4. Email Deliverability & Performance Optimization

* Monitor bounce rates, spam complaints, inbox placement, reply rates, and campaign performance.
* Identify and troubleshoot deliverability issues, authentication problems, and sender reputation concerns.
* Test email subject lines, messaging, calls to action, prospect segments, and follow-up sequences.
* Analyze campaign results and implement improvements to increase positive responses.
* Follow responsible sending practices and applicable email marketing, privacy, and data protection requirements.

5. Lead Qualification & Reporting

* Monitor incoming responses and identify prospects interested in our services.
* Separate positive replies, qualified opportunities, objections, and uninterested responses.
* Pass qualified leads to the sales team with relevant prospect information and conversation context.
* Maintain accurate campaign records and report on verified prospects, deliverability, positive replies, and qualified leads.
* Recommend improvements based on campaign data and lead quality.

Tools & Platforms

* **Lead Research:** Google Maps, Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* **Data Enrichment:** Clay, Hunter, Snov.io, RocketReach, Lusha
* **Email Verification:** Email verification and validation tools
* **Cold Email Automation:** Instantly, Smartlead, lemlist
* **Email Infrastructure:** Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, domain and DNS management tools
* **Data Management:** CRM software, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets
* **Automation & Productivity:** AI writing tools, data enrichment tools, and workflow automation platforms

Skills & Qualifications

* Understanding of B2B lead generation, cold email outreach, and prospect research.
* Experience building targeted prospect lists and identifying relevant business decision-makers.
* Knowledge of email finding, email verification, data enrichment, and database management.
* Familiarity with cold email campaign platforms and automated follow-up sequences.
* Understanding of email deliverability, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce management, and sender reputation.
* Ability to write or optimize personalized cold emails and improve campaign response rates.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret campaign performance metrics.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and familiarity with CRM systems.
* Good attention to detail, organizational skills, and a results-oriented approach.
* Awareness of email outreach compliance, unsubscribe management, and data privacy requirements.

Experience with tools such as Apollo.io, Clay, Hunter, Instantly, Smartlead, or lemlist is an advantage.

Role Objective & Performance Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Accuracy and quality of verified prospect lists.
* Relevance of targeting and decision-maker identification.
* Email deliverability and sender reputation.
* Positive reply rates and engagement from relevant prospects.
* Number and quality of qualified leads generated.
* Database accuracy, campaign consistency, and timely reporting.

We value **quality data, strong deliverability, relevant outreach, and genuine business opportunities** over sending large volumes of emails without a clear targeting strategy.

Who Should Apply?

This role is ideal for candidates with experience or a strong interest in cold email lead generation, B2B prospecting, email marketing operations, sales development, data research, and outreach automation.

If you enjoy researching businesses, building accurate prospect databases, managing email campaigns, troubleshooting deliverability, and turning targeted outreach into qualified sales opportunities, we encourage you to apply.

**Apply now to help us build a reliable pipeline of targeted prospects and qualified business leads.**

We are looking for an experienced, highly organized, and detail-oriented **Senior Production Executive / Production Coordinator** to manage customer orders, factory production follow-ups, shipment coordination, and daily communication with overseas teams.

The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience working with **Chinese factories, international customers, and export shipment processes**.

This is an execution-focused role requiring independent decision-making, excellent follow-up skills, strong written English, and the ability to identify production risks before they become serious problems.

The selected candidate will work closely with our US Sales team, Chinese manufacturing partners, and internal sourcing and production teams.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Production Management & Factory Follow-Up**

* Independently coordinate with Chinese factories regarding production schedules, order status, and shipment readiness.
* Track production progress from purchase order placement through final shipment.
* Follow up on samples, packaging approvals, production milestones, inspections, and delivery commitments.
* Identify potential delays and proactively recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure factories meet agreed production schedules and customer requirements.

**2. Customer Order Management**

* Manage multiple customer orders simultaneously.
* Review purchase orders, quantities, product specifications, packaging instructions, and delivery requirements.
* Maintain accurate order status and delivery tracking reports.
* Coordinate directly with the US Sales team regarding order progress, approvals, and production concerns.
* Ensure all customer requirements are communicated correctly to factories.

**3. Export & Shipment Coordination**

* Coordinate with factories and freight forwarders regarding shipment schedules.
* Track cargo readiness, booking dates, ETD, ETA, and shipping deadlines.
* Follow up on shipment documentation, packing lists, carton details, and related information.
* Identify shipping delays and coordinate recovery plans.
* Ensure orders are shipped according to customer delivery requirements.

**4. Reporting & Data Accuracy**

* Maintain accurate Excel-based production, order, and shipment tracking reports.
* Regularly update order status, production milestones, and expected shipment dates.
* Verify information received from factories rather than simply copying data into reports.
* Highlight discrepancies, overdue approvals, and potential delivery risks.
* Provide clear daily and weekly updates to management.

**5. Problem Solving & Escalation**

* Proactively identify production, quality, packaging, and shipment-related issues.
* Investigate problems with factories and propose practical solutions.
* Escalate critical issues promptly with clear explanations and recommended next steps.
* Follow through until issues are fully resolved.
* Take ownership of assigned customer orders and delivery commitments.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Minimum **4 years of relevant experience** in production coordination, merchandising, order management, or export operations.
* Experience working with Chinese manufacturers or overseas suppliers is strongly preferred.
* Strong written English communication skills are essential.
* Ability to independently draft professional emails to overseas factories and US-based teams.
* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, formulas, and reporting.
* Good understanding of purchase orders, production timelines, packaging approvals, and export shipments.
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies.
* Strong follow-up, time management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to handle multiple orders and priorities without constant supervision.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked as:

* Senior Production Executive
* Production Merchandiser
* Export Merchandiser
* Production Coordinator
* Order Management Executive
* Buying House Merchandiser
* Export Operations Executive

Experience in **toys, gifts, novelty products, licensed merchandise, accessories, home products, or general merchandise** will be an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive sales growth and achieve revenue, order intake, unit placement, and profitability targets for Leica Life Science microscopy solutions within the assigned territory.

##### **Supply Chain Executive – Delhi (JID000093)**

**Position Title: Supply Chain Executive**

**Base Location: Delhi**  
**Department: Supply Chain Executive**

**Division: MI & IVF**

**Primary Role:**

This role sits at the point where finance, service and logistics meet. You will own the receivables cycle from invoice to cash realisation, and coordinate warranty repairs and replacements from request to closure, so that customers are billed accurately, paid on time and supported promptly.

**Job Description:**

* **Accounts receivable management:** Monitor customer accounts and outstanding receivables, issue invoices, statements and collection reminders, and ensure payments are recorded, reconciled and reflected in up-to-date account records.
* **Collections and credit control:** Follow up on overdue invoices with the Sales and Service teams and customers, track collection commitments for timely payment, and escalate long-outstanding accounts as per company policy. Hold regular meetings with Sales and Service for collection support and dispute resolution.
* **Cash application and reconciliation:** Apply customer payments against open invoices, reconcile customer accounts and investigate discrepancies. Resolve unapplied cash, deductions, short payments and credit notes, and support month-end closing for Accounts Receivable.
* **Warranty repair and replacement coordination:** Manage warranty requests from the Sales and Service teams and customers, verify eligibility and documentation, and coordinate with Service, Logistics, Warehouse and vendors/OEMs to process repairs or replacements. Track each case through to closure, ensure timely shipment and return of units, and keep customers updated. Maintain claim records and status reports, and work with Finance on credit notes, billing adjustments and supplier claims.
* **Customer dispute resolution:** Investigate and resolve invoice, payment and warranty-related disputes with the Sales, Service, Operations and Logistics teams, and maintain records of all disputes and claims.
* **Reporting and analysis:** Prepare AR ageing and collection reports, track collection efficiency, overdue balances and warranty claim status, and analyse trends in receivables, disputes and claims. Provide management with periodic dashboards and KPI reports.
* **Compliance and documentation:** Maintain accurate documentation for AR transactions and warranty cases, ensure compliance with company policies and audit requirements, support internal and external audits, and assist in process improvement initiatives.
* **Pricing data accuracy:** Update and maintain product pricing, discount structures and commercial terms in SFDC and SAP as communicated by Principals/OEMs, keeping the data accurate.

**Job Specification:**

* **Key skills and competencies.** **You have strong knowledge of Accounts Receivable and collection processes, along with experience in warranty repair and replacement coordination. You communicate, negotiate, and serve customers well, bring strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, manage multiple priorities against deadlines, and bring a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.**
* **Technical skills.** **You are proficient in G Suite and MS Excel, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, and reporting, and you have experience with ERP systems such as SAP**
* **Education and experience.** **You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field, and have 2 to 3 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Collections, Customer Service, or Warranty**  
  **Administration.**

**Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field.**

**Experience:**

* **2 to 3 years in Accounts Receivable, Collections, Customer Service or Warranty Administration.**

**Why DSS Imagetech?**

* **You will join DSS Imagetech Pvt. Ltd., part of the DSS Group of Companies, a healthcare conglomerate, as a member of the Supply Chain team for the Mi and IVF businesses, reporting to the Supply Chain Manager. The role gives you direct exposure to Sales, Service, Finance, Operations and Logistics teams, and to the vendors and OEMs behind the products, so you see how an order, a payment and a warranty case connect from start to finish.**
